facts.text: Crop rotation improves soil fertility by alternating nutrient demands across seasons
Irrigation systems require regular maintenance to prevent clogging and salt buildup
Nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium (NPK) are the three essential macronutrients for plant growth
Composting organic waste enriches soil with natural nutrients and improves texture
Soil pH balance between 6.0 and 7.0 is optimal for most crops
